policy: Do not activate doses until population, indication, safety, source and QA are reviewed. RDA/UL are not supplement prescriptions.
supported_context: nutritional adequacy and clinically evaluated deficiency risk

protocols.amount: RDA 600 IU/day ages 19–70; 800 IU/day >70; adult UL 4000 IU/day

personalization: Age and dietary context can change relevance; laboratory-based treatment is clinician-led.
safety: kidney disease or interacting drugs -> review
do not infer deficiency from low sun exposure alone
next_review: Distinguish prevention, insufficiency evaluation and deficiency treatment without turning UL into target.
